source_label: Official per-game result feed. 2026-11-13 rows: official scoreboard capture (data/app/official_results_2026-11-13.json). 2026-11-14 rows: official game books (statsdmz.nba.com PDFs). 2026-11-15 rows: every final and every quarter/OT score read 2026-11-16 from the official scoreboard page and each game's official summary page LINESCORES (data/app/official_results_2026-11-15.json carries per-row cross-checks; the ATL@MIL game-book period-table conflict is recorded on that row and flagged). One row per game: date, teams, final score, quarter scores.
settlement_rule: A row is settled only after the final score is verified from official reads (at minimum the official scoreboard; 2026-11-15 rows carry a second independent read from the game summary page). When quarter scores are captured they must sum to the printed final for both sides or the row is withheld and flagged; quarter values that conflict between two official documents are published from the game-page LINESCORES with the conflict recorded on the row and flagged for review, never repaired by hand. Rows without captured quarter scores are settled on the verified final alone, with that noted in the settlement stamp.
